name: manual_a96de3
claim: graduate.py/learn.py/recall.py/show.py print unicode arrows (→) that crash on Windows' default cp1252 console encoding; force UTF-8 stdout/stderr at each script's entry point (sys.stdout.reconfigure) rather than removing the unicode.

decisions.notes: Live-reproduced this session on a fresh Windows shell: python3 .agent/tools/learn.py ... crashed with UnicodeEncodeError on the final print(), even though the actual graduation (file move + jsonl append) had already succeeded. This matches the repo's own documented LINT-007 no-mojibake rule but the 4 .agent/tools/*.py scripts hadn't applied it themselves.
